definition.proposition: Auron injects the input as `+ λ_l·x0` with one learned scalar per *virtual* layer, conditions each shared pass with a per-(loop, block) d-vector added to the GDN input only, and uses U-Net skip vectors and per-block residual scalars (init √1.1); its checkpoint has no learnable RMSNorm weights
